entry.description: 2-hero combo: Hector+Patrick on minxxx defender. WIP no heroes. Both deterministic. Low attacker troops due to WIP availability.

WIP attacks minxxx with attacker heroes Hector 2/3/2, Renee 3/3/3, and Wayne 2/2/2. Attacker fields 1700 infantry_t6 only; defender has no heroes and fields 300 infantry_t6 only. Game report result: attacker 1597 survivors, defender wiped.
Hector solo defender test. WIP attacking no heroes, minxxx defending with Hector (3/4/3). S1 Survival Instincts is 40% chance — run 5+ games. S2 Rampant and S3 Blitz are deterministic.

Norah+Hector+Zinman 3-hero combo — Lanc+Inf+Mark class heroes. Norah S2 splash, Zinman has chance-based skills. RNG test, run 5 battles. WIP attacks (no hero, t6 troops), minxxx defends with all three heroes.
